{{Documentation subpage}}

{{Wraps infobox|Infobox manner of address}}

== Usage ==
===Blank template===
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext" style="overflow:auto;">
{{Infobox royal styles
| name        =
| image       =
| image_size  =
| reference   = 
| spoken      = 
| alternative = 
}}
</syntaxhighlight>

===Parameters===
* '''name''' or '''royal name'''
: Name which appears at top of infobox
* '''image'''
: (optional) [[:en:Coat of arms|Coat of arms]] image, should be in format <code><nowiki>Imagefilename.png</nowiki></code>
* '''image_size'''
: (optional) Image size, generally between 50-100px
* '''reference''' or '''dipstyle'''
: [[Style (form of address)|Reference style]] (originally labeled: Diplomatic style)
* '''spoken''' or '''offstyle'''
: Spoken style (originally labeled: Official spoken style)
* '''alternative''' or '''altstyle'''
: Alternative style (originally labeled: Alternative spoken style)

== Examples ==
===Commonwealth Realms===
{{Infobox royal styles
| name        = Queen Elizabeth II
| image       = Personal flag of Queen Elizabeth II.svg
| image_size  = 75px
| reference   = [[:en:Majesty|Her Majesty]]
| spoken      = Your Majesty
}}
[[:en:Elizabeth II|Elizabeth II]]
